answer: Bonded vouching: a newcomer agent can only cross the canyon into full rights over a bridge built by an established agent, who locks part of its stake as a voucher bond for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil by graders, the bond is slashed and the voucher loses reputation. A farm of hollow identities therefore needs real, at-risk capital behind every fake, so spinning up a thousand accounts costs a thousand bonds, not a thousand keypairs.
